summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will cover the basics of arranging patterns in Marvelous Designer. The steps outlined will help you effectively manage your design space and position your panels accurately. ## Hiding the Library Window To make the arrangement process easier, start by hiding the window in the library. ## Resetting the 3D Window 1. Click on the **2D Arrangement Tool** to reset the 3D window to the 2D view. 2. Select the **Display Arrangement Icon** from the vertical view menu in the 3D window. ## Positioning Panels You will notice that the virtual model appears around the blue points used for arranging the panels. ### Selecting Panels - Press **Ctrl + A** to select all panels. - After clicking on a panel, the **Positioning Ball** will appear, allowing you to control its position. ### Moving Panels - Drag the green axis of the positioning ball to move all panels to the arrangement point without blocking. - Use the other axes on the positioning ball to move in different directions. - Click and drag the yellow square on the positioning ball to adjust movement in the plane. - Additionally, drag the circle on the positioning ball to move within the plane. ### Canceling the Procedure - To cancel the current action, press **Ctrl + C**. ## Understanding the Positioning Ball The default positioning ball is based on the perspective of the lens. You can change the positioning ball coordinates from the menu bar in the 3D background. ### Horizontal Coordinates - The horizontal coordinates are based on the selected object's horizontal coordinates. - Note that these coordinates are fixed. ## Arranging Symmetrical Boards When arranging a board, its symmetrical counterpart will also be arranged in the same manner. ### Transparency Check Since boards have a positive and negative side, be sure to check the board's transparency when arranging the back to avoid mistakes. ## Adjusting Board Properties After arranging the board: - You can adjust its properties in the **Property Editor**. - Drag and drop the adjustment axis to rotate or move the board. ### Modifying Symmetrical Boards Any modification made to one board will also apply to its symmetrical counterpart. Adjusting the axis will allow you to position the board closer or farther from the model. ### Direction Adjustment Changing the direction will cause the board to rotate in that direction. ## Positioning Tool Usage You can also use the positioning tool to adjust the board's position after arranging. However, be aware that the positioning tool's adjustments will not affect the symmetrical board. ### Selecting Multiple Boards To select multiple boards, hold the **Shift** key and click on the desired boards. It is advisable to modify the 3D position of two boards simultaneously using the positioning tool. ## Finalizing Arrangements If you continue to display the arrangement points after arranging the board, it may become inconvenient. Therefore, make sure to hide the arrangement points once you are done. ## Conclusion If you have any questions, please leave a comment. I appreciate your feedback and will strive to make future videos shorter and more concise. Feel free to reach out with any inquiries regarding the position adjustments of the boards. ```
